about: The examples the app lists in its Examples page. "script" is the file that runs; "with" lists the files it needs (local: true = added with Local checked). Paths are relative to this folder. A test checks that every example script is listed here.

examples.shows: Keyboard input, Stop, and finally:
say(), play(), and show()
Drawing a map with draw: shapes, markers, a moving robot, and a saved SVG file
Saving a drawing and carrying on in a later run: draw.save(), draw.load(), clear(), remove(), a background color, and sending room.json to the laptop
Driving a square with spoken updates and a safe stop
Driving a square and showing a photo taken at each corner
Reading the color under the robot and saying the strongest of red, green, and blue
Reporting the light level until Stop, saying "Bright" or "Dark" when it changes
The RVR's own position tracking: driving a square to target positions, printing where it thinks it is at each corner, and drawing its reported path

Mapping a square around the robot with the distance sensor (type the size in meters when asked), drawing each reading live as the sensor's see-through cone (or, with --lines, a line) and saving the map as an SVG file; also runs without a robot (--simulate)
Measuring distance until Stop, graphing it with plot(), and warning out loud when something is close
Showing two lines of text on the display, cleared when you press Stop
Taking a photo and showing it
Showing a photo and saying whether red, green, or blue is strongest in it
Taking a photo with Picamera2 and showing it
YOLO object detection on the Pi: finding and boxing the objects in a photo
Classifying a photo (or an added picture) with a YOLO classification model: its five best guesses of what it shows
Reading the text in a photo (or an added picture) with Tesseract and printing it

A mission using everything at once: explores while avoiding obstacles, photographs each obstacle, watches the floor for a target color, turns on its headlights in the dark, shows its state on the OLED and with its lights, and gives a spoken summary
examples.needs: Sphero RVR+, Pi camera, Qwiic VL53L1X, Qwiic OLED

examples.shows: remote_execute(): functions that run on the laptop, including one given a CSV file from the robot
Looking around with YOLO object detection run on the laptop, saying what it sees
examples.needs: Sphero RVR, Pi camera; Ultralytics on the laptop

examples.shows: The Robot API: reading the distance and ambient light and showing the distance on the OLED
examples.needs: Sphero RVR, Qwiic VL53L1X, Qwiic OLED

examples.shows: The Robot API: driving a square with colored lights, then at each corner reading the floor color and distance, showing a photo, and saying what it found
examples.needs: Sphero RVR+, Pi camera, Qwiic VL53L1X, Qwiic OLED
